b1-magyarsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians Beyond the Border
b1-magyarsag-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks what the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians who live outside Hungary.
b1-magyarsag-01.prompt: Tell the official what Article D of the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians living beyond the borders.
cues: Say what Hungary bears for these Hungarians
b1-magyarsag-01.target: Az Alaptörvény D) cikke szerint Magyarország felelősséget visel a határain kívül élő magyarok sorsáért.
b1-magyarsag-01.english: According to Article D of the Fundamental Law, Hungary bears responsibility for the fate of Hungarians living beyond its borders.
b1-magyarsag-01.canDo: I can say that Hungary bears responsibility for Hungarians who live beyond its borders.

b1-magyarsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Regions Abroad
b1-magyarsag-02.scenario: On a visit to a museum exhibition about the Carpathian Basin, the guide asks you where Hungarians live in the neighbouring countries.
b1-magyarsag-02.prompt: Tell the guide in which country the largest Hungarian community lives and where in Komárom you can study in Hungarian.
cues: Say the country and the region
b1-magyarsag-02.target: A legnagyobb magyar közösség Romániában él, főként Erdélyben. Komáromban a Selye János Egyetemen magyarul is lehet tanulni.
b1-magyarsag-02.english: The largest Hungarian community lives in Romania, mainly in Transylvania. In Komárom you can also study in Hungarian at the Selye János University.
b1-magyarsag-02.canDo: I can identify the historic regions of the Carpathian Basin and their Hungarian communities.

b1-magyarsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Weekend School
b1-magyarsag-03.scenario: You visit a Hungarian weekend school abroad, and the teacher asks what you know about Hungarians in the diaspora.
b1-magyarsag-03.prompt: Tell the teacher what the weekend schools do and which institutions were founded overseas.
cues: Say what the weekend schools help with
Say which institutions were founded overseas
b1-magyarsag-03.target: A hétvégi magyar iskolák segítik a gyermekek anyanyelvi fejlődését. A tengerentúlon Magyar Házak és cserkészcsapatok is létrejöttek.
b1-magyarsag-03.english: Weekend Hungarian schools help the children's native-language development. Hungarian Houses and scout troops were also founded overseas.
b1-magyarsag-03.canDo: I can describe Hungarian diaspora communities across Europe, the Americas, and Australia.

b1-magyarsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The V4 and the EU
b1-magyarsag-04.scenario: At a museum exhibition about Central Europe, the guide asks you about the Visegrád Four and the European Union.
b1-magyarsag-04.prompt: Tell the guide which four countries form the V4 and when Hungary became a member of the EU.
cues: Say the date Hungary joined the EU
b1-magyarsag-04.target: A V4 tagjai Magyarország, Lengyelország, Csehország és Szlovákia. Magyarország 2004. május elsején lett az Európai Unió tagja.
b1-magyarsag-04.english: The V4 members are Hungary, Poland, Czechia and Slovakia. Hungary became a member of the European Union on 1 May 2004.
b1-magyarsag-04.canDo: I can name the four V4 countries and say when Hungary joined the European Union.

b1-magyarsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Simplified Naturalisation
b1-magyarsag-05.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks who can apply in the simplified procedure and what 4 June is.
b1-magyarsag-05.prompt: Tell the official who can ask for simplified naturalisation and what 4 June is.
b1-magyarsag-05.target: Egyszerűsített honosítást kérhet, akinek magyar felmenője van, és tud magyarul. Június negyedike a Nemzeti Összetartozás Napja.
b1-magyarsag-05.english: Someone who has a Hungarian ancestor and speaks Hungarian can ask for simplified naturalisation. 4 June is the Day of National Togetherness.
b1-magyarsag-05.canDo: I can understand the legal process of simplified naturalization for people of Hungarian ancestry.

b1-magyarsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians Around the World
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.scenario: In a conversation with a Hungarian teacher before your citizenship interview, she asks you to sum up what you have learnt about Hungarians abroad.
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher where Hungarians live outside Hungary and how someone with a Hungarian ancestor can become a citizen.
cues: Say how a descendant can become a citizen
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.target: Magyarok élnek a szomszédos országokban és a diaszpórában is. Akinek magyar felmenője van, egyszerűsített honosítást kérhet.
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.english: Hungarians live in the neighbouring countries and in the diaspora as well. Someone who has a Hungarian ancestor can ask for simplified naturalisation.
b1-magyarsag-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about where Hungarians live beyond the border and abroad, and how people of Hungarian descent can become citizens.
